highlights.label: 50% of an arc, not a chord

note: Tolkien: "The best rooms were all on the left-hand side (going in), for these were the only ones to have windows." Every `window` in the file names the same wall. 1 — the doorway is one `arc` clause, and the door sits at 50% of its ARC LENGTH, so the knob lands on the true apex. 2 — seven windows, one wall, none opposite. 3 — 26.9 m² of pantry. 4 — one warning, W_BEDROOM_NO_WINDOW on the Spare Bedroom; `arch suggest` offers to cut a window into the hill.
